title: Mexican Banana Tostada
description: A sweet and unique dessert tostada featuring caramelized bananas and a crunchy tostada crust.
instructions: Arrange tostada shells on a baking sheet.
Bake for 5-7 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
In a skillet, combine sliced bananas and brown sugar over medium heat.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until bananas are caramelized and golden brown.
Stir in lime juice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
To assemble, place a baked tostada shell on a plate.
Top with a caramelized banana slice, sprinkle with cinnamon.
Repeat for remaining tostada shells and banana slices.
